title: Pure Magikey
summary: Magikey cards with five generic Level 4 Normal Monsters of different Attributes, plus generic Rank 4s and staples; the page's Suship and Dogmatika partners are left out. Magikey Fusions, Rituals and Synchros use Normal Monsters as material and get stronger the more Attributes they were made from, so the Normals cover every Attribute. Magikey Maftea Fusion or Ritual Summons, and with a Normal Monster on the field it can use another Normal straight from the Deck as material. Magikey World searches a Magikey monster and fetches Maftea each turn. Magikey Mechmusket - Batosbuster searches any Magikey card when Ritual Summoned. Maginificent Magikey Mafteal grants an extra Magikey Normal Summon and revives a small Normal. Magikey Deity - Ashtartu, the newest card, banishes their monster on their turn if it shares an Attribute with your Normals or Magikeys.
